definition: An opposing team held sole roller control for 0.20 s before a different team established sole control for 0.20 s, or two opponents shared the ball for 0.20 s and a contestant then won 0.20 s sole control. Collapse overlapping events at the same recovery. Exclude possession granted at each restart. Count both colors.
comparison: Compare goals per 90 s and goals per confirmed recovery for mirror teams on all 16 matched ordinary starts. Separately swap colors on the first eight starts against the 31/40 checkpoint. Each game uses a fresh native Webots process. Record a full evaluation match and verify its events and all 9,000 physical samples.
selection: Search over press speed, interception horizon and pass/shoot preference in full native mirror and cross-play. Rank by own recovery goals per team-game plus own fraction of recoveries converted. Break ties by lower candidate index.
